# within family

Anchors a reified kinship relationship in the family group it belongs to — the structural seam GEDCOM exchange requires (a child's family, a marriage's family). Optional: kinship claims stand alone; the family anchor is added when the family-group structure is itself a documented fact (#34 phase 3 — consumers: the gedcom projection and the published genealogy profiles).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/withinFamily>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:withinFamily`
